verdict.oneLineSummary: Fast and painless developer experience: standard OAuth2 with immediate multi-workspace connection.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent create issues, update cycles, and read project roadmaps?
capabilityCheck.detail: Linear has a high-performance GraphQL API. Full read and write capabilities are supported across issues, comments, roadmaps, and teams with no artificial capability ceiling.

steps.text: Go to Linear Settings → Account → Security & access → Applications → Create new.

fields.name: Scopes
fields.note: Linear scopes are clear and grant immediate workspace access without manual approval.

steps.text: Copy Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.note: Ready to authenticate immediately in development or production.

blockers.issue: Actor authorization nuance: Linear OAuth tokens act on behalf of the installing user. If the user leaves the workspace, the token is invalidated.
blockers.workaround: Recommend connecting with a dedicated machine user / bot user account in large enterprise workspaces.

composio.recommendation: Composio provides ready-to-use Linear integration with clean tool calling for issue management.

evidence.claim: Linear supports public OAuth 2.0 without review gates; users can authorize instantly.
evidence.label: TESTED
